stories.title: All eight CDU state premiers back Merz — “gemeinsam mit dem Bundeskanzler”

facts.text: All eight CDU Ministerpräsidenten issued a joint statement opposing personnel speculation and pledging to work “gemeinsam mit dem Bundeskanzler” (Tagesspiegel ~11:34 / SPIEGEL).
Three tenets: Bundestag majority (no minority-gov trial balloons); work with all democratic forces (AfD firewall); trust via action, “nicht über Personaldiskussionen” (SPIEGEL).
Merz’s circle welcomed the support; CSU’s Söder was informed but not asked to sign — he said Tuesday he expects Merz to keep Präsidium backing Sunday (SPIEGEL).
Context unchanged: MV/Berlin votes Sunday; CDU Präsidium Sunday evening; Merz already cancelled next week’s UN General Debate trip (morning).

stories.whyItMatters: First coordinated Länder-chef firewall against ouster talk — but SPIEGEL notes the “jetzt” framing leaves room after Sunday’s polls.

stories.title: BBC Verify: East-West pipeline pumping-station damage may take 4–6 weeks

facts.text: BBC Verify satellite imagery shows major damage at a pumping station on Saudi Arabia’s East-West Pipeline — the Red Sea export workaround after Hormuz disruption (BBC).
Kpler’s Homayoun Falakshahi: repairs could take four to six weeks given spare parts and impaired supply chains; closure risk cited up to ~3.6 mb/d (~3.6% global demand) (BBC).
Trade sources (Reuters via Al-Monitor): Saudi told some European customers September cargoes will be cancelled; Yanbu loadings remain suspended; dated Brent ~$122 vs futures near $108 (Al-Monitor).
Separate Monday imagery: damage to hangars at King Khalid Air Base near Khamis Mushait after Houthi strikes; Mecca drone intercept was morning’s related thread (BBC).

stories.whyItMatters: Turns yesterday’s Yanbu pause into a multi-week Red Sea export outage with European cargo cancellations — material upgrade vs morning’s loading halt.

image.alt: A satellite image of a damaged oil refinery

stories.title: von der Leyen: no personal social accounts under 15; mini accounts 13–15

facts.text: SOTEU: von der Leyen previewed EU Kids Act — “No personal account under 15. No social media under 13”; only parent-supervised mini accounts 13–under-15 (Euronews).
Full draft due Thursday; covers social/video platforms plus safety-by-design for games and AI chatbots/companions; age-verification via EU-wide app or national tools (Euronews).
Draft bans infinite scroll / artificial notifications / some rewards; DSA systemic services need Commission OK for child-affecting features; supervisory fee (Euronews).
Golem afternoon DE write-up frames the same 13+ mini-account / autonomous from 15 ladder for Social Media (Golem).

stories.whyItMatters: Hardest EU-wide age ladder yet for big platforms — SOTEU makes the leak political reality ahead of Thursday’s formal proposal.

image.alt: 'Enough is enough': EU moves toward restricting social media access for under-15s

stories.title: Google: Pixel modem CVE-2026-58704 under limited targeted exploitation

facts.text: Pixel Bulletin: CVE-2026-58704 “may be under limited, targeted exploitation”; High modem EoP (permission bypass); adjacent/proximal, no user interaction (AOSP).

Patch level 2026-09-05 or later covers the issue; BleepingComputer: ~110 Pixel vulns in the drop including multiple Critical RCEs; Google urges install via Settings → Security update (BleepingComputer).
Golem afternoon DE alert covers the same modem zero-day under active pressure (Golem).

stories.whyItMatters: Rare Google admission of in-the-wild Pixel modem exploitation — patch today if you’re still below 2026-09-05.

stories.title: Lithuania: downed drone carried explosives; likely path from Belarus

facts.text: Defence Minister Robertas Kaunas: the drone Italian Eurofighters shot down overnight Mon→Tue near Pratkūnai carried explosives; specialists have defused the charge; no casualties (tagesschau ~08:39).
Early assessment: likely entered from Belarus; origin still under investigation. President Nausėda thanked NATO responders (tagesschau).
FM Wadephul: another sign of Russian hostility toward NATO allies; von der Leyen tied Baltic/European incidents to a “broader pattern” of Russian aggression (tagesschau).

stories.whyItMatters: First explosive payload confirmed after a NATO shootdown over Lithuania — escalates the recent drone/balloon harassment thread.
